description: Get which mail clients (Apple Mail, Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, Thunderbird, Android mail app, web browser, other) and device types (desktop, mobile, tablet, unknown) opened your emails, as shares of unique opens. Pass campaignId for one campaign (all time); omit it for the whole company over period or start/end (default 90d) with an optional emailType. Each email send counts once, attributed to the client of its first open. Gmail, Yahoo and Apple Mail Privacy Protection fetch images through proxies, so those opens report the client with an unknown device; privacyProxyOpens counts them. Report shares, not absolute reach: recipients who never open are not represented. New Outlook for Windows and Outlook.com count as web_browser, and some WebKit apps such as Outlook for Mac count as apple_mail.

campaignId.description: Campaign ID for a single campaign's breakdown. When set, period, start, end and emailType are ignored.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

emailType.description: Company-wide structural email type filter: campaign, sequence, or transactional.

end.description: Company-wide custom range end as an ISO 8601 timestamp; provide start too.

includeMachineEngagement.description: If true, include machine-classified bot/scanner opens and clicks. Defaults to false, so metrics and activity are human-only.

mailboxProvider.description: Optional recipient mailbox provider filter, for example gmail, microsoft, or yahoo.

period.description: Company-wide time period: 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, or 90d. Defaults to 90d.

start.description: Company-wide custom range start as an ISO 8601 timestamp; provide end too. Maximum range is 90 days.

name: get_email_client_stats

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_email_client_stats` MCP tool.

campaignId.description: Campaign the breakdown covers. Present only for a campaign breakdown.

clients.description: Mail clients, most opens first. key is apple_mail, gmail, outlook, yahoo_mail, thunderbird, android_mail_app, web_browser, or other; share is the unrounded percentage of totalOpens.

items.description: One client with key, label, opens, share.

devices.description: Device types, most opens first. key is desktop, mobile, tablet, or unknown; share is the percentage of totalOpens.

items.description: One device with key, label, opens, share.

emailType.description: Applied structural email type filter when one was requested.

end.description: Custom range end when start/end was used.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

mailboxProvider.description: Applied recipient mailbox provider filter when one was requested.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

period.description: Applied company-wide period (custom for start/end). Absent for a campaign breakdown.

privacyProxyOpens.description: Opens through Gmail, Yahoo or Apple Mail Privacy Protection proxies, which hide the device.

start.description: Custom range start when start/end was used.

totalOpens.description: Unique opens (one per email send) the breakdown covers. 0 means nothing was opened, so clients and devices are empty.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
